Features of the unit

1) cooling towers, housings are made of high strength glass fiber.

2) advanced internal design, excellent cooling effect, low noise operation, low energy consumption.

3) anti-corrosion and anti-harsh environment and strong ability to facilitate maintenance.

4) Mainly used in all sectors of the national economy, cooling, air conditioning heating furnace and condenser technology, injection molding machine series is particularly suitable for cooling water circulation.
